description: INE’s basic-services tables cover electricity generation and consumption, piped natural-gas consumption and drinking-water consumption. They also provide annual customer and connection counts by category. The provider is Instituto Nacional de Estadística Bolivia. Coverage: Coverage is Bolivia. Current labels give monthly series from 2017 or 2018 through 2026 and annual customer or connection series through 2025. Access: The official table index and series labels were read. Numerical tables were not downloaded. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: Some entries are indices while others are physical volumes or counts. Base-year and unit definitions must be checked before combining them. For simulation they supply multi-service demand and generation calibration aggregates. Related resources: This national statistical series is distinct from the CNDC operational electricity services.
